methodologyNotes: Covers desktop craft and hobby cutting machines (electronic die/vinyl cutters and drag-knife plotters) sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes industrial CNC routers, laser engravers, wide-format sign plotters, and manual die-cut presses. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. cuttingForceGrams is maximum downforce in grams-force (gf) as published by the manufacturer; null if not disclosed. maxMaterialWidthIn is the widest media the machine accepts, in inches. maxCutLengthIn is the maximum continuous cut length on a cutting mat, in inches. maxMaterialThicknessMm is the thickest material the machine can cut, in millimeters. toolSystem is an enum describing the carriage: single-tool, dual-carriage, or adaptive-tool. compatibleToolCount is the number of interchangeable blades, tools, or pens the machine officially accepts. printAndCut is a boolean: true if the machine reads registration marks to cut around printed designs. matlessCutting is a boolean: true if the machine feeds roll or smart material without a carrier mat. connectivity is an enum: usb, bluetooth, or both. software is the name of the native design application. weightGrams is machine weight in grams.
